integrity: The proof is analytic; a standalone symbolic checker audits only finite algebraic identities. Novelty comparisons are bounded and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact global result for the specified unperturbed zero-linear-damping cubic family; no results for generic linear damping or numerical certification of infinite-time claims. Qualitative portraits and local focal/period jets already occur in earlier literature.
title: Global algebraic relaxation and renormalized logarithmic phase at a cubic Liénard weak focus
